ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 45% low-intensity (black) pixels in the central and proximal regions vs 55% high-intensity (white) pixels on the distal lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region features a contiguous black mass extending from the peduncle toward the mid-lobes. Outer lobes are predominantly white. Left lobe contains a cluster of three parallel high-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) and four isolated low-intensity circular spots. Right lobe contains seven distinct low-intensity circular spots and heavy mottling at the distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 28 degrees at the central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous low-amplitude serration along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged irregularity and pixel-level fragmentation detected at the distal tip of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature along the leading edges, sweeping from the peduncle junction to the sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Left distal lobe: 4 circular low-intensity clusters (~3-5px diameter). Right distal lobe: 7 circular low-intensity clusters (~2-8px diameter) distributed across the white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of three parallel high-intensity linear marks on the dark inner field of the left lobe; one isolated high-intensity linear mark on the dark inner field of the right lobe near the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake marks on the left lobe; significant irregular tissue loss or heavy scarring at the right lobe distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The intersection of the triple-linear white rake marks with the black-to-white pigmentation boundary on the left lobe provides a unique geometric signature.
